hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; lint_out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint "$f" 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "$lint_out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
